title.value: Questions Are All You Need to Train a Dense Passage Retriever
title.justification: The title clearly indicates the main focus of the paper on training a dense passage retriever using questions.
title.quote: Questions Are All You Need to Train a Dense Passage Retriever

extractions.description: The paper introduces ART, a novel approach for training dense retrieval models without labeled training data. ART relies on an autoencoding method using questions to retrieve evidence passages, then using these passages to reconstruct the original question. The aim is to enable unsupervised learning of retrieval models that can be incorporated into Open QA systems without further finetuning. Extensive experiments show ART achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple QA benchmarks, emphasizing the efficiency and effectiveness of training with only questions.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is developing and improving machine learning techniques for information retrieval and question answering, which does not directly relate to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Dense retrieval is a cen- tral challenge for open-domain tasks, such as Open QA
